title: org.ligatureprotocol.capability.clipboard
description: DRAFT. The clipboard capability (spec chapter 05 section 3b): user-scoped, text only in this version. The descriptor's params say how much text the device accepts. The capability's stream (purpose org.ligatureprotocol.capability.clipboard, ADR 0036) carries set messages in both directions: the sender's clipboard changed to this text at this time. The receiver applies the newest by setAt and ignores a set equal to what it holds. The domain ligatureprotocol.org is a placeholder; it is not yet registered.

params.description: The descriptor's params for this capability.

maxBytes.description: The largest text, in UTF-8 bytes, this device accepts in one set. Never more than the frame limit of ADR 0036.

mimeTypes.description: The content types this device offers and accepts. Only text/plain in this version.

set.description: The sender's clipboard now holds this text.

mime.description: Content type of text; only text/plain in this version.

setAt.description: When the sender's clipboard took this value; the newest wins.
